name: Quote drafting assistant
problem: Tradespeople spend evenings writing quotes and lose jobs to faster competitors.
non_goals: No pricing advice. No changes to the invoice template.
line: model call. Line items come from the price book in fixed code; only the job summary is drafted by a model.

name: Invoice chasing
problem: Small trades businesses wait weeks to get paid and chase invoices by phone.
non_goals: No debt collection. No late fees.
line: model call. Reminder timing is fixed code; the reminder wording is drafted by a model.

name: Mobile job sheets
problem: Job notes are written on paper and retyped at the office.
non_goals: No offline maps. No scheduling changes.
line: fixed code. Forms and sync only; no model call.

name: Supplier price sync
problem: Price books go stale when supplier prices change.
metric: Price book entries older than 30 days
line: model call. A model matches supplier line items to the price book.

name: Trade directory listing
problem: Customers cannot find a tradesperson nearby.
line: fixed code. Listings and search only.

name: Crew scheduling
problem: Crews are double-booked when office staff schedule by hand.

name: Owner reporting dashboards
problem: Owners cannot see which jobs make money.
line: model call. Figures are computed in fixed code; only the weekly summary is drafted by a model.
